commentary.speaker: play_by_play
commentary.text: Coverage is underway with 3.86 kilometers of walking now officially on the record.

commentary.speaker: color
commentary.text: The fastest verified section is on the board. The replay desk is declining to call it a sprint.

commentary.speaker: stats_desk
commentary.text: The broadcast reaches its verified high point at 218 meters.

commentary.speaker: color
commentary.text: One kilometer down. The legs have filed no formal objection, which apparently counts as consent.

commentary.speaker: play_by_play
commentary.text: He has now been walking long enough for this to qualify as a programming decision.

commentary.speaker: field_reporter
commentary.text: Yup, he’s still walking. For some reason he’s decided to go back to the stairs!!!!!!!

commentary.speaker: color
commentary.text: The stairs remain available. Unfortunately, so does his free will.

commentary.speaker: stats_desk
commentary.text: Three kilometers. At this point the sidewalk is basically a coworker.

commentary.speaker: field_reporter
commentary.text: A verified low point, geographically. Spiritually, the booth stopped measuring.

commentary.speaker: play_by_play
commentary.text: The route is complete. Officials can confirm that continued walking is no longer required.
